name: LineChartCard
description: Composable line-chart card with title, timeline range selector, legend (basic or detailed), error boundary, and an optional min/max/avg footer
descriptionFull:
Composable line-chart card with title, timeline range selector, legend (basic or detailed), error boundary, and an optional min/max/avg footer.

Accepts either pre-shaped `data` or `rawData` + a `dataAdapter` callback so upstream domain components can keep their data wrangling local

props.name: data
props.description: Pre-adapted chart data (use this OR rawData+dataAdapter)

props.name: rawData
props.description: Raw data to be transformed by dataAdapter

props.name: dataAdapter
props.description: Adapter to transform rawData into LineChartCardData

props.name: detailLegends
props.description: Show detail legends with current values

props.name: shouldResetZoom
props.description: Whether to reset zoom on timeline change (default: true)

props.name: chartProps
props.description: Pass-through props to the core LineChart

props.name: headerAction
props.description: Optional action rendered on the right of the card header (e.g. an expand toggle). Passed straight through to `ChartCont…
props.descriptionFull: Optional action rendered on the right of the card header (e.g. an expand toggle). Passed straight through to `ChartContainer`. Additive - omit it and the card header is unchanged

props.name: titleExtra
props.description: Optional node rendered next to the title (e.g. an info tooltip). Passed straight through to `ChartContainer`. Additive

fields.name: value
fields.description: Timeline key passed to `onTimelineChange`, matched against `timeline` and passed to the chart's `timeline`. Known keys:…
fields.descriptionFull: Timeline key passed to `onTimelineChange`, matched against `timeline` and passed to the chart's `timeline`. Known keys: `1m`, `5m`, `30m`, `3h`, `1D`

fields.name: disabled
fields.description: Renders the option greyed out and unselectable — a range the current data source cannot serve, say. Honoured by both th…
fields.descriptionFull: Renders the option greyed out and unselectable — a range the current data source cannot serve, say. Honoured by both the card's range selector and `TimelineSelector`
